<thought>We need a single-step retrosynthesis that disconnects the product into a ketone precursor and an alkene precursor via the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene reaction. To find an appropriate template we search the catalog for a reaction that breaks an alcohol (formed) and forms a ketone and an alkene, with the bond‑order changes C=O→C‑O and C=C→C‑C. The search will return a template ID that we can use in the retrosynthesis JSON.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene", "ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C=O (2.0->1.0)", "C=C (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
